title: PO Response Schema
description: Schema for PO [Product Owner] (Pax) structured response back to ULTRON. Contains backlog items, validation results, prioritized tasks, and epic coherence reports.

agent.description: Agent identifier — always 'po' for this response schema

status.description: Overall status of the PO's work. 'success' = mission completed fully, 'partial' = completed with caveats, 'error' = could not complete.

summary.description: 1-2 sentence summary of what the PO produced. Used by ULTRON for consolidation.

artifacts.description: Concrete outputs produced by the PO's backlog and requirements work

title.description: Descriptive title of the backlog item

priority.description: Priority level of this backlog item

estimatedEffort.description: T-shirt size effort estimation: P(pequena), M(media), G(grande), XG(extra grande)

acceptanceCriteria.description: List of testable acceptance criteria for this backlog item

backlogItems.description: Backlog items created or reviewed during the mission. Empty array if no backlog items were produced.

validationResult.description: Result of story/requirement validation. Null if validation was not part of the mission.

storyId.description: ID of the story or artifact that was validated

verdict.description: Validation verdict: approved (ready for implementation), needs_revision (fixable issues), rejected (fundamental problems)

taskId.description: ID of the task or backlog item being prioritized

justification.description: Why this item was given this priority rank

prioritizedTasks.description: Tasks or backlog items ordered by priority with justification for each ranking

epicCoherence.description: Epic coherence analysis result. Null if epic coherence check was not part of the mission.

epicId.description: ID of the epic being analyzed for coherence

coherenceScore.description: Coherence score from 0.0 (completely incoherent) to 1.0 (perfectly coherent)

misalignments.description: List of identified misalignments between stories and the epic context

issues.description: Issues or blockers encountered during the PO's work

metadata.description: Meta-information about the PO's work process

missionType.description: Type of mission the PO executed, derived from mission.description analysis

autoDecisions.description: Number of autonomous decisions made (documented as [AUTO-DECISION] in free text)

storiesValidated.description: Number of stories validated during this mission

freeText.description: Optional free-text field for additional unstructured context (Phase 1 hybrid mode)

position.description: Agent's position in Deliberative Group Chat. Format: 'agree_with:{agent}', 'disagree', or 'propose:{alternative}'. Null when not participating in a group chat round.
